titulo.alumno: «Se pudesse, escolheria…»: if I could, I would choose…

intro: Read the text and tell a remote hypothesis apart from a possible future with «se».

palabras.significado: In context: If I could work fewer hours, I would study more in the evening.
In context: Leonor says she wouldn't move city at this moment.

texto: Tell a remote hypothesis apart from a possible future with «se».
Compare the literal information with the purpose of the text; don't add details that don't appear.
